_fields.listen: Local address to bind for local applications; its transport follows the target automatically
_fields.target: Optional backend declaration: tcp://host:port or udp://host:port; must pass the server allow_targets list (omit to use the server default)
_fields.edns0: Announce 1232-byte UDP answers via EDNS0 (set on BOTH ends or the tunnel stalls)
_fields.domain: Authoritative DNS tunnel domain matching the server domain
_fields.servers: Upstream DNS resolvers (supports standard UDP/TCP :53, DoT tls://, and DoH https://)
_fields.record_type: DNS query record type: txt (recommended), null, cname, a, aaaa, mx, srv, ns
_fields.pubkey: Server Noise Curve25519 static public key for end-to-end AEAD encryption
_fields.log_level: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
